Scale-Space Two-Sample Wrapper

Source: R/scale_space_resampling.R
scale_space_twosample.Rd

Thin raw-image wrapper around scale_space_energy using fixed-size two-group label permutations.

Usage

scale_space_twosample(
  subject_images,
  group,
  mask = NULL,
  scales = scale_space(c(6, 10, 14, 18, 24, 32, 48)),
  statistics = list(local_energy(), signed_coherence(tail = "two")),
  n_perm = 1000,
  seed = NULL,
  variance = c("welch", "pooled"),
  z_equiv = TRUE,
  template = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  studentize = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

subject_images

List of subject-level 3D images, or a subject-by-voxel matrix with template/mask.

group

Two-level group label.

mask

Optional logical mask.

scales

Scale-space specification.

statistics

List of scale-space channel objects.

n_perm

Number of label permutations.

seed

Optional random seed.

variance

"welch" (default) or "pooled".

z_equiv

If TRUE, return Z-equivalent maps; otherwise return t maps.

template

Optional template for matrix inputs.

alpha

FWER level.

studentize

Whether to studentize scale-space fields.

...

Additional arguments passed to scale_space_energy.
